classification.difficultyReason: Determine the retained-value multiplier, calculate the depreciated value, and interpret a sale below that value.

content.prompt: The Backyard Rubbish Experts bought a fleet of small trucks for $\$1340000$ and depreciated them at $22.5\%$ p.a. Five years later they sold them for $\$310000$. Was the price that they obtained better or worse than the depreciated value, and by how much? Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.short:
Worse by $\$64639.28$.

The sale price is below the value obtained using five years of depreciation.
answer.worked:
Each year the trucks retain $100\%-22.5\%=77.5\%$ of their value.

$$\begin{align*}V_5&=1340000\times(0.775)^5\\V_5&=\$374639.280664\ldots\\\text{Sale shortfall}&=1340000\times(0.775)^5-310000\\\text{Sale shortfall}&\approx\$64639.28\end{align*}$$

The price obtained was worse than the depreciated value by $\$64639.28$.
